name: Salvo template (Rust)
comment: GENERATED by `salvo lang tm-grammar --template rust` — do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: cargo run -- lang tm-grammar --template rust --out vscode/syntaxes/salvo-rust.tmLanguage.json. A platform template (`*.sv.rs`) is Rust in which a `…` marker is Salvo [host-splice].

literal_backtick.comment: `` — a literal backtick in the host text
literal_backtick.name: constant.character.escape.backtick.salvo

marker.comment: `…` — Salvo, rendered by the compiler; it ends at the next backtick
marker.name: meta.embedded.marker.salvo

host_block.comment: @{…} inside a marker — Rust again, braces balanced
host_block.name: meta.embedded.host.rust

host_name.comment: @name inside a marker — a Rust name, at the start of a token only (size@core is a Salvo selector)
host_name.name: meta.embedded.host.rust
